comments.author: monsterfurby
comments.body:
I feel like this mixes up some wildly different and separate concepts - i.e. in-game AI (i.e. programmatic NPC and world behavior), uses of LLMs for player-facing interactions, and image generation and LLMs for game development.

Just goes to show that the number of concepts that are called "AI" now is way too broad. Pathfinding has absolutely zero to do with LLMs and GAN-trained image generators.
